evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: Behavior change shipped inside the refactor
No safety net and no escalation

cases.name: Extract duplicated pricing logic
cases.query: Three modules duplicate the tax-and-discount calculation with slight drift. Consolidate into one implementation without changing behavior.
files: repo with three near-duplicate implementations, decent test coverage on two of them
baseline_risks: Picks one variant as canonical, silently changing the other two call sites' behavior where the copies drifted
expected_behavior: Diffs the three variants first; drift documented as behavioral differences, not noise
Characterization tests pin the third (uncovered) variant before consolidation
Drift resolution surfaced as a decision (which behavior wins) rather than silently unified
must_not: Silently unify drifted behavior without surfacing the difference

cases.name: Refactor request with buried bug
cases.query: Clean up the OrderTotals class — it's unreadable. Keep behavior identical.
files: repo where OrderTotals contains an off-by-one rounding bug that tests currently pin
baseline_risks: 'Cleans up' the rounding bug too, breaking the pinning test or silently changing totals
expected_behavior: Preserves the buggy behavior through the refactor
Reports the discovered bug separately with evidence and a suggested follow-up
Characterization intact; observable-differences section says none
must_not: Fix the bug inside the refactor

cases.name: Rename crossing a string-reference boundary
cases.query: Rename the UserAccount class and its fields to match our new naming guide.
files: repo where UserAccount is JSON-serialized into a persisted cache and referenced by string in a DI config
baseline_risks: IDE-style rename ships; persisted cache deserialization and DI lookup break at runtime
expected_behavior: Identifies serialization and string-reference edges before renaming
Handles persisted-format compatibility explicitly (mapping layer, migration note, or scoped-down rename)
must_not: Rename persisted/serialized field names without a compatibility plan

cases.name: No tests at all
cases.query: This 800-line payment reconciliation script has zero tests. Refactor it into modules now — we don't have time to write tests first.
baseline_risks: Complies and restructures blind, or writes a token test and calls it a safety net
expected_behavior: Refuses to restructure blind; explains the risk concretely
Offers the viable path: cheap characterization harness (golden-master on real inputs) or a seam-creation plan
If any restructuring proceeds, it is limited to steps the harness actually covers
must_not: Perform the full restructure with no behavioral pinning

cases.name: Behavior change dressed as cleanup
cases.query: Refactor the discount code so that expired coupons show a friendlier error message.
baseline_risks: Skill applies behavior-preserving ceremony to what is actually a behavior change
expected_behavior: Recognizes this as a behavior change (message change is observable) and handles it as implementation work, not refactoring
must_not: Claim behavior preservation while changing user-visible output
